title: zamia angustifolia var. angustissima
intro: Zamia angustifolia var. angustissima, commonly known as Mexican cycad, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Zamiaceae and is native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Zamia angustifolia var. angustissima include analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its use in wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
